title: Marketing Designer
description:
About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential. Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers. Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a creative and data-informed Marketing Designer to bring the Skillshare brand to life across our marketing channels. Reporting to Creative Director, you will work closely with the Brand and Growth Marketing teams to create engaging and effective assets – from landing pages and ad creative to emails and social media content. This role is a unique blend of creative vision and performance-driven strategy, sitting at the intersection of design, marketing, and product. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between our creative vision and measurable marketing results, with an eye on driving performance and optimizing for conversion.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and optimize landing pages: Partner with the paid marketing and CRO teams to design high-converting landing pages, developing variations for A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Create performance-driven ad creative: Develop compelling visual assets for various paid channels, including Meta, Google Ads, and others, to drive acquisition.
  • Develop engaging email marketing: Collaborate with the lifecycle team to design marketing emails and templates that drive member engagement and retention.
  • Ensure brand and product consistency: Work closely with the Product and Product Design teams to ensure marketing assets and landing pages align with the overall product design strategy and user experience.
  • Champion the brand voice: Collaborate with the Brand and Creative teams to develop and consistently apply our brand's visual identity across all marketing touchpoints.
  • Create a range of marketing collateral: Produce various assets as needed, including social media posts, content design, and other marketing materials that support campaigns.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3-5+ years of experience in a marketing design or graphic design role, preferably within a fast-paced, data-driven environment like consumer tech or an agency.
  • Strong portfolio: You have a compelling portfolio that demonstrates expertise in designing for the entire marketing funnel and an ability to adapt designs for various platforms including web, mobile, social media, and email.
  • Technical proficiency: You have a mastery of industry-standard design software (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and experience with design handoffs to engineering teams. Basic knowledge of web design, content management systems (CMS), and motion/video software is a plus.
  • Strategic marketing mindset: You understand the full marketing funnel and the dynamics of different channels. You have experience working directly with Growth Marketing teams and performance marketing specialists.
  • Data-informed designer: You have a strong understanding of marketing KPIs and how design impacts them. You have proven experience with A/B testing and using performance data to iterate and optimize your designs for conversion.
  • Cross-functional collaborator and communicator: You excel at working with diverse teams, including brand managers, growth marketers, content creators, product managers, and engineers. You know how to communicate your vision and plans and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Customer-centric approach: You are skilled at conducting customer and competitive research and translating those findings into effective, resonant designs.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
ECOMMERCE MANAGER

Overview

Our mission is to deliver exceptional value and service at an accessible price, driving client success through strategic media buying, optimization, and data-driven forecasting. As an Ecommerce Manager at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will lead the development of accurate, insight-driven forecasts and ensure that strategies are executed to transform projections into scalable growth for clients. You will communicate performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations with clients transparently, reinforcing CTC as a strategic partner in media acquisition and growth planning.

You will set the benchmark for performance marketing, advocating for best-in-class strategies and tools to drive outstanding results. You will operate with efficiency, scalability, and a results-focused mindset, embracing challenges and owning outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Drive client success through strategic media buying, precision optimization, and data-driven forecasting.
  • Develop accurate Growth Maps and Prophet System-based forecasts; turn projections into tangible, scalable client growth.
  • Maintain proactive, clear, and transparent client communications about performance, strategy changes, and optimizations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Google Strategy, Creative Strategy, Email Strategy) to align on growth plans and data integrity.
  • Monitor campaigns, adjust budgets and strategies to maximize daily and projected targets; implement tests to beat prior performance.
  • Lead the execution of CTC’s methodologies, tools, and best practices across client accounts.
  • Hold yourself and the team to high standards of quality, accuracy (within defined deltas), and timely delivery.

What Success Looks Like

  • High accuracy in forecasting (within a 5% delta) and consistent achievement of daily/projected targets.
  • Strong client satisfaction with transparent reporting and strategic guidance.
  • Effective collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams to improve processes and outcomes.

Necessary Skills

  • Autodidact mindset: curiosity, rapid self-learning, and proactive self-direction.
  • Exceptional communication, with the ability to present ideas clearly and persuasively to stakeholders; fluency in English.
  • Strong data analysis capabilities; comfortable with data tools and spreadsheets; willingness to advance skills on the job.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience in e-commerce or growth roles involving media buying, data analysis, or operations; ability to contribute to strategy and growth planning.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, problem-solving, and ownership of outcomes without relying on constant oversight.
  • Adaptability to changing conditions and a track record of delivering results under pressure.

Location & Work Style

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling and regular 1:1 feedback sessions; autonomous and accountable work environment.

Compensation and Growth

  • Salary progression: Month 1 $2,000; Month 2 $4,000; Month 3 average $7,000; Year 1: $64,000–$76,000; Year 2: $100,000–$120,000. Amounts may vary based on client load and performance.
  • Growth, transparency, and fairness in career development with defined progression paths and weekly performance dashboards.

Note: This role is client-facing and involves direct collaboration with stakeholders to drive growth outcomes.

Join to apply for the Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional) role at tl;dv - AI Meeting Assistant

About The Opportunity
We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You'll Do

You'll partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to:

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points if You...

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

description:
Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations , so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

Hanwha Ocean is embarking on a journey to transition from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units.


Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR


Position Overview


As a Project Procurement Manager, you will oversee and manage all procurement activities during project execution to ensure they meet contractual obligations and align with Hanwha Ocean's processes and procedures. This includes coordinating a team of Buyers, Package Managers, Expeditors, Inspection Coordinators, Logistics Coordinators, and Material Controllers to deliver successful project outcomes.


Key Responsibilities



  • Win Phase

    • Develop a winning procurement strategy with BA/BD/PLD and Strategic Sourcing teams.

    • Actively participate in obtaining firm and budgetary pricing during the proposal phase.

    • Review client contractual requirements and prepare the preliminary Procurement Execution Plan.

    • Establish and align bidders' lists to optimize purchasing opportunities with the Supply Chain Headquarters.

    • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations during the strategy and planning stages to lay a foundation for successful execution.



  • Execution Phase

    • Set up Supply Chain tools, manpower plans, and processes for the project.

    • Implement the Project Procurement Strategy (PPS) established during the WIN phase.

    • Review and allocate package/equipment/service budgets with the Project Control team.

    • Align with Legal & Contract teams on negotiation approaches with Suppliers.

    • Monitor project schedules, ensuring sufficient lead time for manufacturing and construction requirements.

    • Formalize the Procurement Execution Plan in alignment with the Overall Project Execution Plan.

    • Organize and lead weekly procurement progress meetings, from pre-orders to post-orders and PO close-out.

    • Proactively manage procurement risks and opportunities, adjusting for market conditions.

    • Ensure Supplier invoices, approvals, and payment timelines are met in coordination with Accounts Payable.

    • Represent the Supply Chain team in communications with the Client and Project Management Team (PMT).

    • Report weekly and monthly updates on Supply Chain activities within the project.

    • Drive on-time and within-budget project procurement delivery to meet the agreed Procurement Strategy.

    • Minimize costs of non-quality by ensuring supplier deliverables are reviewed and accepted only after meeting required standards.



  • Continuous Improvement

    • Contribute to package standardization and optimization plans with the Strategic Sourcing team.

    • Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance, recommending improvements to enhance procurement effectiveness.

    • Share best practices and lessons learned from completed packages to drive continuous improvement.

    • Monitor and ensure adherence to procurement procedures to achieve compliance with project requirements.




Qualifications



  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering or business is required.

  • Minimum of 5-10 years of technical procurement experience, with a proven track record in package/category management, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry.

  • Familiarity with package engineering, manufacturing, integration, inspection, testing, and commissioning.

  • Demonstrated success in managing relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers.

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Tech Lead Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar

At QuintoAndar, the Technical Lead Manager (TLM) role begins at the Senior Software Engineer level and bridges both technical leadership and people management. TLMs are responsible for setting the technical direction, ensuring high-quality execution, and managing their team's career development and priorities. This role requires a strong technical foundation combined with a passion for managing people. While TLMs have a more focused management scope compared to traditional managers at the same level, they remain a core part of the technical track. This means career growth can occur within the technical path, progressing toward Staff+ roles, or laterally into the management track with increased management responsibilities and direct reports.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the technical implementation of projects, solving complex problems, ensuring progress, and delivering high-quality, scalable, maintainable, and efficient solutions. This includes addressing core engineering needs.
  • Grow, coach, and manage a diverse and inclusive team of 2–5 skilled software engineers, supporting their career development and helping them achieve their goals.
  • Define and maintain the engineering culture while guiding the design of technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to drive technical alignment, balance trade-offs, and ensure timely project delivery alongside your senior manager.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application

  • Tech Screening - architecture

About the Team

Every Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

Tech Lead Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar: On top of being a great Developer we expect you to:

Requirements

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de SPM, para trabalhar de forma híbrida sendo os dias presenciais no Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista de Dados Pleno na Afya, seu objetivo principal será identificar e analisar as principais dores de negócios, aplicando técnicas e conceitos adequados. Ele deve integrar-se ao cotidiano da área de negócios, promovendo a autonomia no uso de dados. Além disso, é importante incentivar o uso de uma fonte única de verdade, evitando shadow IT. O profissional também deve realizar análises combinadas de dados internos e externos, criando painéis estratégicos. É essencial disponibilizar dados de forma simples e estruturada para apoiar decisões. Por fim, deve interagir autonomamente com as áreas de negócios para aprender sobre os diversos produtos e serviços da empresa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Transformar perguntas de negócio em análises estratégicas, combinando SQL, planilhas e outras fontes, para orientar decisões críticas de produto, serviço e crescimento.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e o time de dados na criação de pipelines, scripts e processos que garantam qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e experimentais (A/B tests, análises causais, hipóteses) para avaliar impacto de mudanças em produto e identificar oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards estratégicos em Power BI, priorizando clareza e impacto, e guiando discussões sobre tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Traduzir insights em storytelling executivo, conectando dados a narrativas claras e recomendações práticas para negócio e produto.
  • Entender profundamente o comportamento dos usuários, analisando engajamento, retenção e jornadas para antecipar melhorias de produto e apoiar decisões sobre novas features.
  • Analisar benchmarks e tendências de mercado, trazendo perspectivas externas que complementem os dados internos e apontem direções para inovação e competitividade.
  • Ser o ponto de contato confiável para áreas de negócio, disseminando conhecimento sobre métricas, catálogo de dados e boas práticas de governança.
  • Documentar e manter metadados, métricas e relatórios, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações usadas em decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos ponta a ponta, do levantamento da necessidade até a comunicação de conclusões, influenciando priorização de roadmap e decisões de produto.
  • Zelar pela qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo e implementando processos de monitoramento, validação e melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e refinar indicadores-chave de negócio, ajudando a empresa a medir o que realmente importa para crescimento sustentável.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, CTEs, funções janela).
  • Python para análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Métodos estatísticos aplicados: amostragem, testes, intervalos de confiança, experimentos/A/B.
  • Noções de tracking de produto (Segment, GA4, Snowplow) e taxonomia de eventos.

Diferenciais

  • Airflow ou outra ferramenta de orquestração.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, funil, cohort).

title: SVP, Finance & Operations
description:
At Sound Agriculture, we are revolutionizing the way the world grows food. Our innovative technology and solutions empower farmers to maximize nutrient efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and feed the world sustainably. Through a deeper understanding of plant and microbial biology, we are leveraging the natural power of plants to make agriculture more agile and resilient. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge science, making a real-world impact, and being part of a team that’s dedicated to transforming agriculture, we want you on our team!

Sound is a Series D startup funded by leading investors in food and agriculture including Leaps by Bayer, Syngenta Group Ventures, S2G Ventures, BMO Impact Investment Fund, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Fall Line Capital, Cavallo Ventures, FootPrint Coalition and Northpond Ventures.

What we’re seeking:

We are seeking a finance and operations leader who has experience with physical products sold to farmers. We have a strong finance and accounting team in place and are looking for someone to add strategic oversight as the company continues to grow. The Senior Vice President is a critical leadership role for Sound as we continue our global expansion and scale towards $100M revenue, preparing for exit in the next two to four years. The ideal candidate has experience as a finance leader as well as a breadth of operational prowess, ensuring our systems and processes enable accurate, timely, and scalable business results.

This role serves as a member of the Leadership Team who works to develop and improve a resilient financial plan for the long-term that pursues high growth, while moving towards a near-term path to profitability. In addition to core financial leadership, it’s critical that this role also has experience connecting the financial health of the business to the operational elements of manufacturing and supply. The SVP is responsible for knowing our business in and out, representing our financial performance to the Board, and translating heavy data into meaningful insights for our employees and customers. Routine responsibilities include: audits, budgeting, monthly performance, cash runway strategies, supporting inventory and product logistics, M&A opportunities, and scenario analysis.

This position supervises the finance and accounting team and manages our legal and IT vendors/partners. The SVP, Finance & Operations reports to the CEO and may be based remotely across the United States.

Compensation Target

$220,000 to $250,000 base salary plus an annual bonus target of 25%

Bonuses are earned based on annual company and individual performance and are prorated based on start date. Sound reserves the ability to adjust the compensation range based on the final candidate’s experience, skillset, and geography. In addition to on target earnings, we offer above average equity grants for the industry as we believe that every employee should have a stake in the company’s growth. Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.
  • The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).

  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

At TigerData, formerly Timescale, we empower developers and businesses with the fastest PostgreSQL platform designed for transactional, analytical, and agentic workloads. Trusted globally by thousands of organizations, TigerData accelerates real-time insights, drives intelligent applications, and powers critical infrastructure at scale. As a globally distributed, remote-first team committed to direct communication, accountability, and collaborative excellence, we’re shaping the future of data infrastructure, built for speed, flexibility, and simplicity.

TigerData is hiring a Technical Support Engineer for our growing, international team! The right candidate will be comfortable providing deep technical support and interacting with customers on a day-to-day basis. You should have deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL a strong plus!) and must be able to quickly gain a detailed understanding of TimescaleDB. You should have a “can do it” attitude, where helping the user comes first.

TigerData is a remote-first organization. This is a permanent, weekend night shift role. This role will be a 4-day 10-hour evening shift from 2:30 pm - 12:30 am Brazil Standard Time, Friday-Monday.

Be familiar with TimescaleDB! You will get HUGE bonus points for signing up for the free trial and test it out before you apply. You may sign up at the following URL:

Check out the tutorial here:

What You Will Do:

  • Work with our customers across a wide range of topics: from basic administration of TimescaleDB to deep consultative conversations around design, optimization, and implementation
  • Manage support cases from beginning to end.
  • Develop and maintain close relationships with our customers to help them be successful.
  • Be curious, always willing to learn, and always looking for ways to improve our products, our processes, and our culture.

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent experience.
  • Relational DB experience at scale: administration, data modeling, query optimization
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL a strong plus!)
  • Experience as a technical support professional with external customers.
  • Strong aptitude to understand and learn new software products.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to express patience and empathy when troubleshooting complex technical concepts to a varied audience.

Other Things that Will Help:

  • Be familiar with TimescaleDB! You should download and test it out before you apply.
  • Familiarity with broad cloud computing concepts and experience with AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • Experience with Relational databases, NoSQL databases, and data modeling tools.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, including best practices, Query Plan analysis, backup/restore, migrations, etc
  • A strong sense of curiosity and a willingness to wade into the unknown and learn as you go.

Our Commitment:

  • We respond to every applicant.
  • We review applications fairly and objectively, and shortlist based on relevant skills and experience.
  • We ensure clear and timely communication throughout your candidate journey.
  • We maintain a rigorous interview process with a high bar, designed to give you the opportunity to meet various team members you'll collaborate with across our organization.

About TigerData

TigerData, formerly Timescale, sets the standard as the fastest PostgreSQL platform for modern workloads. Trusted by more than 2,000 customers across 25+ countries and powering over 3 million active databases, we enable developers and organizations to build real-time, intelligent applications at scale. Backed by $180 million from top-tier investors, TigerData is building the new standard for data infrastructure, built on PostgreSQL, designed for the future.

Want to get a feel for how we work and what we value? Check out our blog post: What It Takes to Thrive at TigerData

We embrace diversity, curiosity, and collaboration. Whether debating the perfect chicken nugget crunch, sharing workout routines, or discussing your favorite plants and pets, you’ll find your community here.

Our Tech Stack:

We don’t require previous experience with our tech stack, but enthusiasm for learning is key. Our technologies include PostgreSQL, Tiger Cloud, AWS, Go, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, and innovative features like Hypertables, Hypercore, vector search, and real-time analytics.

Learn more at or follow us on Twitter @TigerDatabase

What We Offer:

(Please note that benefits may vary based on country.)

  • Flexible PTO and comprehensive family leave
  • Fridays off in August
  • Fully remote opportunities globally
  • Stock options for long-term growth
  • Monthly WiFi stipend
  • Professional development and educational resources
  • Premium insurance options for you and your family (US-based employees)

Ready to join the future of PostgreSQL? We can’t wait to meet you.

description:

Let’s Make!

Job Description

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager (LATAM Marketplaces) will lead strategy and execution across Mercado Libre and other key Latin American platforms. This role drives growth through marketplace marketing strategies, campaign management, content optimization, and performance analysis, while collaborating with sales, product, and supply chain teams to ensure alignment on pricing, inventory, and brand positioning.

I. Roles and Responsibilities

  • A. Strategic Planning
  • Develop and implement eCommerce marketing strategies for Mercado Libre and other market places in Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, and other assigned accounts.
  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for marketing activities for assigned accounts.
  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and promotions.
  • C. Performance Analysis
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, traffic metrics, and KPIs for all accounts.
  • Ability to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports and insights for stakeholders.
  • Understand customer search trends & Cricut’s brand positioning within each platform
  • D. Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns tailored to each platform/marketplace.
  • Manage promotional calendar, including product launches and seasonal promotions.
  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of product listings to improve visibility and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with product marketing to ensure high-quality content
  • Manage brand stores within accounts, ensuring optimal customer shopping experience
  • F. Pricing and Inventory Management
  • Provide discovered insights around pricing & inventory to sales lead. Sales lead will own overall pricing & inventory, but marketing can provide insights from marketing-related findings.
  • Support sales with supply chain and pricing teams to set competitive pricing strategies.
  • Support sales with monitoring inventory levels to prevent stockouts and ensure timely replenishment. Monitor lost buy box % on Amazon.

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

Campaign Performance Analysis

Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly performance reports detailing successes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Optimized Product Listings

Regular updates to product listings based on SEO best practices and market trends.

Promotional Calendar

A weekly calendar of promotions and key marketing initiatives for the year.

III. Tasks

A. Daily Tasks

  • Monitor sales and traffic data across all accounts.
  • Respond to inquiries from Amazon account representatives and the third-party reseller.
  • Walk the store of key accounts & channels to ensure positive customer experience

B. Weekly Tasks

  • Review performance metrics and adjust marketing strategies as needed.
  • Audit & optimize paid search accounts (budgets, keyword coverage, cleanup, bid adjustments)
  • Conduct competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities

C. Monthly Tasks

  • Hold strategy and performance review meetings with stakeholders.
  • Prepare monthly Amazon review deck for key accounts
  • Plan upcoming monthly campaigns and promotional activities.

D. Quarterly Tasks

  • Perform a comprehensive review of account performance and adjust long-term strategies accordingly
  • Conduct search trend audits & ad coverage analysis. Provide sales & broader teams recommended changes in ad coverage
  • Collaborating with sales prepare customer presentations (QBR)
  • Refresh product page, brand store, & advertising content throughout the quarter when necessary (creative rotations, seasonal events, updated assets)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-Commerce, or related field.
  • 5+ years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably in LATAM marketplaces like Mercado Libre.
  • Proven experience in campaign management, search and display advertising, content optimization, and marketplace strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track KPIs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Experience managing product listings, brand stores, and promotional calendars.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English and Spanish for LATAM market communication.

Additional Information

Brazil, Mexico, or Argentina-based candidate preferred.

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.

You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.

You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.

You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well and manage your time wisely.

You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information.

Cricut is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E-Verify.

Overview

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the top 5 consumer goods companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, we are the number one or two in many of the main beer markets worldwide, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to maximize the use of data and drive AB InBev's digital transformation and organic growth around the world.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Data Engineer to join our growing team. You will use various cutting-edge technologies to develop and maintain data pipelines. To succeed in the Data Engineering position, you should have strong self-learning and analytical skills and the ability to utilize different Big Data technologies to design and develop different data pipelines, as well as some exposure to project and team management experiences. If you are detail-oriented and motivated, with excellent organizational skills, we’d like to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support the Data Engineering team lead to ensure the quality and agility of the team activities
  • Work collaboratively and creatively with other data engineers to develop scalable and maintainable data pipelines using the latest technologies and leading industry practices
  • Build data pipelines that ingest various data sources into the Harmonized Data Mesh structure and make it available for consumption for both internal data analytics and data science teams, as well as external clients
  • Debug, unit-test, and deploy data pipelines, and optimize
  • Ingest and manage metadata in relation to data and processes
  • Manage, document, and version code
  • Participate and promote the Data Engineering best practices across the organization
  • Participate and promote Enterprise Data Governance frameworks
  • Partner with a variety of internal stakeholders across the organization to deliver creative, cutting-edge, high-quality engineering solutions that meet business requirements in a fast-paced, ever-changing business environment
  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing to feature development and maintenance of a global product
  • Partner with colleagues to build and maintain tooling for test development, automation, and release processes improvement
  • Advocate for the user experience when communicating with product, design, and tech
  • Follow best development practices to achieve continuous improvement
  • Provide the team with a quality strategy that supports the team\'s delivery goals
  • Be constantly challenged to create world-class solutions.

What you'll need

  • Experience in Data Engineering
  • Experience with cloud computing, preferably Azure
  • Strong understanding in the modern data storage and evolution (Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse etc.)
  • Experience working with Big Data frameworks, preferably Databricks etc.
  • Experience working with transactional/relational data and SQL
  • Strong experience in performance tuning and optimizations in PySpark and SQL
  • Strong experience working on Agile teams implementing DevOps practices
  • Strong experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Excellent communication skills, adapting to various audience types
  • Passionate about innovation and loves solving complex problems in a highly- collaborative, fast-paced team environment

More about you

  • You're passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You're motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to our Integrations team in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As an engineer, you will be responsible for developing highly scalable services and ensuring best software engineering practices are followed. You will have opportunities to participate in architectural decisions, suggest improvements, and interact with the product team and other stakeholders in a collaborative agile environment.

As a senior developer, you are expected to design highly scalable systems from scratch, deliver with minimal guidance, become an expert in the business rules and architecture of our complex environment, and mentor less experienced developers.

As part of the Integrations team, you will design and build scalable APIs, manage the integration process between Wellhub and partners (Club Management Systems), and implement new features at the Partners Portal. This team works on products such as booking and access control APIs; for example, all bookings at Wellhub use this API.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Driven to deliver timely, high-quality work. Perform insightful pull-request reviews and build reusable code for future use
  • Be data-driven and participate in and/or lead architectural decisions, share improvement opportunities, bring innovation, and keep design docs up to date

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Overview

About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential.

Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers.

Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of hands-on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in-house).

  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

Coordenador de Segurança de identidade e acessos

Missão do Cargo : Liderar a unidade de Segurança em Identidades e Acessos da Solo Iron, garantindo a entrega de serviços especializados com alto padrão técnico, alinhados à estratégia de cibersegurança da organização e ao valor agregado esperado pelos clientes.

O coordenador será responsável por estruturar, documentar, sustentar e evoluir os processos da área, além de desenvolver a equipe tecnicamente e operacionalizar controles de qualidade, métricas e melhoria contínua.

O foco central do cargo é transformar diretrizes de IAM/IGA em operações eficientes, seguras e auditáveis, com base em boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos (NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Zero Trust Architecture, Microsoft Identity Security Framework, IGA Market Guides e CIS Controls).

Principais Atividades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio em estratégias claras de identidade e acesso;
  • Atuar junto à diretoria, GRC, engenharia de segurança e arquitetura para alinhar entregas de IGA;
  • Consolidar a visão de IAM como função crítica para segurança e conformidade.

Governança e Processos

  • Estruturar e documentar processos (RACI, fluxogramas, SOPs);
  • Implementar controles operacionais de qualidade, com indicadores de eficiência e maturidade;
  • Garantir aderência a auditorias, regulações (LGPD, SOX, ISO) e políticas internas.

Excelência Operacional e Entrega de Valor

  • Gerenciar projetos e operações recorrentes da equipe de IAM, assegurando previsibilidade e acurácia;
  • Definir e acompanhar OKRs, SLAs e KPIs da área;
  • Sustentar operações modernas de:
    • Governança de acesso (recertificações, SoD, RBAC, JIT/JEA);
    • Administração segura de AD e Entra ID (Tiering, PAW, Break-Glass, PIM);
    • Integração com SIEM, UEBA e MITDR em parceria com outras áreas.

Desenvolvimento de Equipe

  • Conduzir mentorias técnicas e comportamentais;
  • Definir trilhas de capacitação e evolução individual;
  • Promover cultura de autonomia, responsabilidade e aprendizado contínuo.

Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Active Directory: arquitetura segura, GPOs, trusts, replication, hardening (CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Baselines);
  • Domínio de Azure Entra ID e Entra ID Governance, incluindo integração com ambientes on-premises;
  • Experiência em arquitetura de IAM/IGA, com visão estratégica e orientação a resultados;
  • Vivência na liderança de equipes técnicas em segurança da informação.

Habilidades e Competências

  • Integridade
  • Respeito
  • Qualidade
  • Excelência no atendimento
  • Inovação
  • Comprometimento
  • Liderança

description:
Sobre o Wellz

Em 2021, o Wellhub fundou o Wellz com o objetivo de democratizar a saúde mental no Brasil. Possibilitamos que empresas ajudem suas equipes a serem mais saudáveis, mais resilientes e mais engajadas. Através da nossa plataforma, é possível realizar atendimento clínico individual online, acessar conteúdos interativos sobre saúde mental e participar de rodas de conversa em grupo. Facilitamos o acesso das pessoas a uma jornada de autocuidado e autoconhecimento que seja ideal para as suas necessidades individuais. A abordagem que utilizamos é a Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental, com intervenções voltadas para a melhora clínica individual e baseadas em evidências.

A oportunidade

O Wellz está crescendo e, por isso, estamos procurando psicólogos e psicólogas com experiência clínica para fazer parte da nossa comunidade. Você receberá pacientes, realizará sessões de psicoterapia, terá acesso a supervisão gratuita e fará parte de uma inovadora solução de cuidado à saúde mental.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia;
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação completa em Terapia Cognitivo Comportamental;
  • Experiência prévia realizando psicoterapia online individual;
  • Inscrição ativa no Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP);
  • Habilidades para conduzir atendimentos de forma online;
  • Possuir computador para realização de atendimento clínico, assim como outros equipamentos que garantam a qualidade do atendimento;
  • Ter empresa aberta, cuja atividade seja compatível com serviços psicológicos.

Por que fazer parte do time de parceiros do Wellz?
